items.summary: Handoff: retain four evidence-backed opportunities as deferred backlog only; do not create proposals, change requests, experiments, telemetry, dependencies, spend, deployments, or monetization work this cycle. 1) deeppenetrations.com /reviews/liquid-wrench: 95 impressions, position 2.8, 0 clicks. Prototype: reversible title/meta and onsite-intent alignment patch. Metric: GSC clicks and CTR. Learn: 14 days or 100 new impressions. 2) broadwayshowgirls.com /writers/priya-raghunathan: 64 impressions, position 2, 0 clicks. Prototype: reversible title/meta and internal-link refinement. Metric: clicks and CTR. Learn: 14 days or 100 new impressions. 3) americastrikes.com: mobile performance 65, LCP 4861ms, TBT 492ms. Prototype: isolated asset/rendering diagnosis with no dependency or production change. Metric: lab LCP/TBT. Learn: one bounded diagnosis cycle. 4) Fleet content normalization using microsoft/markitdown (MIT; 187237 stars; lab supported, 8/8 checks passed): prototype fixture-only conversion of a small representative document set to Markdown, with provenance and diff review. Metric: valid structured output and editor time saved; learn: one lab run. Risks: MIT is favorable, but dependency/security review, parser correctness, prompt/content provenance, maintenance fit, and production integration remain unverified; do not install or adopt yet. shadcn-ui/ui (MIT; 124671 stars; lab supported, 3/3 checks passed) remains a UX research candidate for accessible CTA primitives, with prototype-only component extraction and bundle/accessibility review. mermaid-js/mermaid (MIT; 90443 stars; lab supported but no native checks) remains a content-visualization candidate; prototype only a manually authored isolated SVG and review sanitization, accessibility, page weight, and maintenance before adoption. These are prioritization and learning signals, not revenue, ROI, conversion-lift, or causal-impact evidence. Preserve the affiliate attribution guardrail: the dated aggregate commission remains unattributed.
